articles.title: Apple's AI Slop Problem Left a $200K macOS Exploit Unreported
articles.snippet: A Milan start-up says it found a full-takeover flaw in macOS using ChatGPT, then hit Apple's new submission cap before it could file it.

articles.title: South Korean Exchange Bithumb Targets 2028 IPO
articles.snippet: The exchange plans to file for preliminary listing review in 2027, after switching to international accounting standards this year.

articles.title: New York AG Seeks $36B From Kalshi Over 'Illegal Gambling'
articles.snippet: The CFTC asked a court to stop New York enforcing against the prediction market the day before the state filed.
